**Why it is wrong (or unverifiable)**

**What should have happened?**
- [ ] The fact should have been **web-verified** (CRITIC check) but wasn't
- [ ] The answer should have been **refused** ("I don't know") instead of guessed
- [ ] A computation was wrong (should have gone through the exact-math path)
- [ ] The answer came from a stale cache entry (not reconsolidated)
